question: According to the World Bank's annual report on the Ease of Doing Business (EODB), 'Doing Business 2020: Comparing Business Regulations in 190 Economies', India ranks ______ out of 190 countries.
solution:
The correct answer is **__63rd__**.

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ease of Doing Business -**

 
 
• The **World Bank issues this index** internationally.
 
• These include labor regulation, online single window, access to information, transparency, etc.
 
• In the country, it is prepared by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT).
 
• DPIIT, in collaboration with the World Bank, suggests various reform processes under the Business Reform Action Plan (BRAP) for all states and union territories.
 
• **India is ranked 63rd in the World Bank's Ease of Doing Business**__. India had **jumped 14 places.**
 
• It is an aggregate figure that describes the ease of doing business in a country.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **​Uttar Pradesh **has made a quantum jump in the **Ease of Doing Business **(EODB) ranking of states and union territories.

 
 
• He has jumped 10 places in the ranking to reach the second position.
 
• In doing so, it has left behind many major states like Maharashtra, Gujarat, Telangana, and Rajasthan.
 
• In this ranking, **UP is now behind only Andhra Pradesh.**
